lines.zh: 我的长耳朵垂下来，湿的。
lines.en: My long ears hang down, wet.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩下去声音不对。

lines.en: I walk with an empty saddle frame.

lines.zh: 我的脊背上一排新的骨。
lines.en: A row of new bone runs down my back.
I drag one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方尘土发黑。
lines.en: The dust blackens where I pass.
Only half my tail is left.

lines.zh: 我沿着牲口道，往人声那边。
lines.en: Along the cattle track I head toward the sound of voices.
I walk with a pause between steps.
There's an opening in my flank.
I brush along the wooden rail.
I stop at the stable door.
I stand, the saddle frame still on me.
One ear swivels back and lies against my neck.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛有一只是白的。
lines.en: One of my eyes has gone white.

lines.zh: 地上的草在我脚边枯了。
lines.en: The grass withers at my feet.
I'm chewing a bit of hide.

lines.zh: 脖子一节一节地沉下去。
lines.en: My neck sinks downward joint by joint.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看棚顶的破口。
lines.en: I lift my head to the hole in the stable roof.

lines.zh: 我侧着头，等棚里那声叫。
lines.en: Head tilted, I wait for that call from the stable.

lines.zh: 你袖子上有旧皮带的气味。
lines.en: Your sleeve carries the smell of old leather straps.

lines.zh: 我从草堆后面把脸抬起来。
lines.en: I raise my face from behind the hay pile.
One of my legs isn't right.

lines.zh: 你别过身，我知道你要走。
lines.en: You turn your shoulder; I know you mean to leave.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋一侧，想听懂你。
lines.en: I tip my head to one side, trying to understand you.
I can't open my mouth very wide.
You'd best not come too close.

lines.zh: 我记得你骑上来的动作。
lines.en: I remember how you used to mount.
I step back; my leg weakens.
A flap of hide peels open.

lines.zh: 跌了半步，我把蹄子扎紧。
lines.en: I stumble half a step and plant my hooves hard.
Something aches deep in the bone and I grunt.

lines.zh: 疼得我把脖子整个垂下去。
lines.en: The pain drags my whole neck down.
I haven't eaten that in a long time.
Don't hold it up — just set it on the ground.

lines.zh: 草味近了，我往前挪半步。
lines.en: The hay smell is closer; I shift forward half a pace.
That handful of hay won't even fill the gaps in my teeth.
I chew and chew, but it still won't go down.
I just can't get it down.
There's fodder smell on your hands.
Reach your hand over again; I won't bite it.
I lower my head for it.

lines.zh: 你肩膀顶进我的肋边，很闷。
lines.en: Your shoulder drives into my flank with a dull thump.
The knock shifts me half a step.

lines.zh: 门框太窄，我们的肩卡住。
lines.en: The doorframe is too narrow and our shoulders jam.

lines.zh: 撞了一下，我的腿还立着。
lines.en: One knock, and my legs are still holding.
Her saddle frame is still on.

lines.zh: 两个脑袋低下来，抵在一处。
lines.en: Two heads come down and rest against each other.
She has an opening in her flank too.
We walk out of the stable together.
I came to a stop too.
I pick up a piece of fodder.

lines.zh: 我拿鼻子顶它，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I nudge it with my nose and it rolls halfway over.

lines.zh: 蹄子一落，就把它按进泥里。
lines.en: A hoof comes down and presses it into the mud.

lines.zh: 拖了几步，蹄印一路划过去。
lines.en: I haul it a few paces, hoof marks scoring the ground behind.
I can't chew through this one; leave it.

lines.zh: 耳朵向前压平，风里有味。
lines.en: My ears flatten forward; there's a scent on the wind.

lines.zh: 它低着头吃草，没看见我。
lines.en: It grazes with its head down and hasn't seen me.
It walks ahead, and I stay three paces behind.

lines.zh: 一条腿拖着走，蹄声不齐。
lines.en: One leg drags, and my hoofbeats fall uneven.

lines.zh: 我咬进它的肩，牙根发酸。
lines.en: I bite into its shoulder and my tooth roots ache.

lines.zh: 背上那块骨撞在它身上。
lines.en: The bone on my back strikes it.

lines.zh: 前蹄压下去，它翻不过来。
lines.en: My forehoof comes down and it can't roll free.

lines.zh: 牲口棚门口多了一个影子。
lines.en: A shape appears at the stable door.

lines.zh: 我从饲料堆后面走出来。
lines.en: I come out from behind the feed.
The saddle frame is still on me.
This stable used to be mine.

lines.zh: 蹄子一抬，我往气味那边去。
lines.en: One hoof lifts and I head toward the smell.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，鞍架发红。
lines.en: Fire catches my back; the frame glows red.

lines.zh: 摔下来时我的蹄先着地。
水灌进我的嘴，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I can't lift my head.
The blast rolls me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一根尖刺进了我的侧腹。
光打在我身上，皮下滑热。
lines.en: Light strikes me; heat slides under my hide.

lines.zh: 饿得眼前发黑，蹄子打滑。
lines.en: Hunger darkens my sight and my hooves slip.

lines.zh: 雷顺着背骨走，我全身僵了。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my back bone; I lock up.
